a.title: Art supplies
a.stem: A school orders 24 boxes of markers. Each box holds 36 markers and costs $2.35.
parts: How many markers are in the order?
864 markers
The markers are sorted into bins of 18. How many bins are filled?
48 bins
What is the cost of the 24 boxes?
The school pays with $60. How much change does it get?

a.title: Garden bed
a.stem: A garden bed is a rectangle 3 1/2 feet long and 2 1/4 feet wide. A raised planter next to it is a rectangular prism 6 feet long, 3 feet wide and 2 feet tall.
parts: What is the area of the garden bed?
7 7/8 square feet
How many feet of edging go all the way around the garden bed?
11 1/2 feet
What is the volume of the planter?
36 cubic feet
Soil comes in bags of 2 cubic feet. How many bags fill the planter?
18 bags

b.title: Field trip
b.stem: 138 students and 12 adults go on a field trip. Each bus holds 44 people and costs $187.50.
parts: How many people go on the trip?
150 people
How many buses are needed?
4 buses
What do the buses cost in all?
The cost is shared equally by all the people. How much does each person pay?

b.title: Rain gauge
b.stem: The rainfall each day for 8 days, in inches: 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1/2, 1, 3/4, 1/2, 3/4.
parts: Make a line plot of the data. On how many days was the rainfall 3/4 inch?
3 days
What was the total rainfall for the 8 days?
5 inches
What is the difference between the most and the least rainfall in one day?
3/4 inch
If the total rainfall were shared equally among the 8 days, how much would fall each day?
5/8 inch
